title: Returns, Cancellations and Fee Reversals on the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan
content:
The Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan reverses principal and fees in the following cases, and in no others.

## Principal returned

When a transfer's delivery fails or the receiving institution returns the funds, its whole principal is reversed by a transfer return pointing to the transfer, booked within the tier's principal reversal period in business days of the failure or return notice with reason delivery failed or returned by receiving institution, and the transfer's fee is reversed in full with the same reason.

When the tier allows cancellation before the submission cutoff, a next-business-day transfer the worker cancels before the next-business-day submission cutoff on its request date is reversed the same way with reason cancelled before cutoff; an instant transfer, or a next-business-day transfer after that cutoff, can never be cancelled or reversed at the worker's request. A transfer is returned at most once.

## Fee reversed, principal standing

- An instant transfer whose delivery minutes exceed the tier's instant delivery standard has its fee reversed with reason instant delivery late when the tier carries the late instant refund.
- A next-business-day transfer whose delivered date is later than its expected delivery date has its fee reversed with reason next-business-day delivery late when the tier carries the late next-business-day refund.
- In both cases the principal stands.
- A second fee booked for the same transfer is reversed with reason duplicate fee.
- Beyond these, the desk may grant one courtesy reversal of a fee at the worker's request only while the worker's courtesy reversals in the 365 calendar days ending today, across every plan the worker holds, are below the tier's courtesy reversals per 12 months; a tier allowing none grants none.

## Request window

A fee reversal of any reason is booked only within the tier's fee reversal request window in calendar days of the fee's entry date. Calendar days are counted from the day after the fee's entry date, so the last day to ask is the entry date plus the window. Reversals for delivery failure, returns, cancellations and late delivery are booked on the notice without a request, which falls well inside that window; a duplicate fee or a courtesy reversal needs the worker's request inside it, and after it no fee is reversed for any reason.

*Boundary (hypothetical, 45-day window, fee entry date 2 October):* 16 November is the entry date plus 45 days and is the last day to ask; a request on 17 November is outside the window.

## Form of a reversal

A fee is reversed at most once. A reversal always reverses the whole fee, points to it, and carries the fee's payday and fee type. Where the fee was already recovered on its payday, the reversal leaves a credit on the plan that is applied against the next payday's amount due; it is never paid out in cash.

| Event | Principal | Fee | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| Delivery failed | reversed | reversed | delivery failed |
| Returned by receiving institution | reversed | reversed | returned by receiving institution |
| Next-business-day cancelled before cutoff | reversed | reversed | cancelled before cutoff |
| Instant delivered late | stands | reversed | instant delivery late |
| Next-business-day delivered late | stands | reversed | next-business-day delivery late |
| Second fee on one transfer | stands | second fee reversed | duplicate fee |
